purpose: Release evidence checklist; does not alter runtime access or attest legal compliance.

gates.subject: AniList and redistributed catalogue/media rights
gates.requiredEvidence: Written permission or documented applicable terms covering ALM tracking, caching, redistribution and actual revenue; identify each media owner.

gates.subject: Minors and legal bases
gates.requiredEvidence: Publisher audience/age decision and legal basis for each optional processing; implement the corresponding server rule or parental process, then test existing and new accounts.

gates.subject: Vercel eligibility and contracts
gates.requiredEvidence: Actual account plan, usage and applicable executed agreement; qualify donations and commercial use without assuming their amount or legal effect.

gates.subject: Remote backup restoration
gates.requiredEvidence: Encrypted off-site export, retention and a successful isolated restoration including Auth and rights/deletion replay; source migrations and local application backups alone do not prove recovery.

gates.subject: Privacy information and operating procedures
gates.requiredEvidence: Identifiable responsible publisher, alternative privacy contact, mailbox/log/backup retention and deletion proof, applicable processor/transfer agreements and rights/incident drill.

gates.subject: Native Windows distribution
gates.requiredEvidence: Install NSIS as standard user, verify signature when supplied, cold --maintenance through Task Scheduler, backup/restore, update and uninstall with explicit handling of user data.

gates.subject: DMARC monitoring
gates.requiredEvidence: Only tighten after legitimate senders and alignment are verified and a report mailbox has been chosen; do not enable reject automatically.

gates.subject: Electron embedded Node/Brotli/Undici security
gates.requiredEvidence: Electron 45.3.1 (official Node 24.22.2) is pinned in package and lock; regenerate a clean Windows NSIS build, validate its bundled runtime, run the 160-suite regression plan, verify SHA-256, and repeat VM installation and data persistence checks before distributing binaries.

gates.subject: Production alignment and strict account deletion confirmation
gates.requiredEvidence: La migration Supabase 20261025060253_alm_beta82_delete_confirmation.sql a été appliquée et vérifiée le 25/10/2026 ; vérifier la concordance du site publié avec le manifeste V2.0.0 Bêta stable. Ne pas redéployer automatiquement.

gates.subject: Real authentication and email journeys
gates.requiredEvidence: Confirm Supabase Auth CAPTCHA/SMTP configuration and perform consented sign-up, confirmation and recovery tests. Read-only DNS/provider checks and historical delivery counts do not establish these journeys.
